corrected_summary.summary_en: PLVR searches external tool-control programs, executes candidates and selects retained versions using teacher-action distance and training-task outcomes before freezing them for new tasks. It uses a handwritten seed and a library of primitives and rules generated by frontier models from teacher traces.
corrected_summary.summary_zh: PLVR 搜索外部工具调用控制程序，实际执行候选后依据教师动作距离和训练任务结果选择保留版本，冻结后用于新任务。程序依赖人工种子与前沿模型从教师轨迹生成的原语和规则库。

old_summary.summary_en: PLVR searches external tool-control programs, executes candidates and selects retained versions using teacher-action distance and training-task outcomes before freezing them for new tasks. The programs rely on a manually constructed primitive and rule library, rather than discovery from scratch.
old_summary.summary_zh: PLVR 搜索外部工具调用控制程序，实际执行候选后依据教师动作距离和训练任务结果选择保留版本，冻结后用于新任务。程序依赖人工建立的原语和规则库，不是从零自动发现。
